nodes.description: Public mapping(address=>uint) token balances; written directly without SafeMath in transferFrom and batchSend.
Public nested mapping(address=>mapping(address=>uint)) spending allowances mutated in approve and transferFrom.
Privileged owner address set in the constructor from msg.sender and checked by most administrative functions.
Whitelisted trade address written by setTradeAddress and read by ensure().
Per-address sale counter incremented in transferFrom and bounded by _saleNum in condition().
Mapping(address=>bool) whitelist flag set by _mints and consulted by ensure().
Minimum sale amount configured by init() and enforced in condition().
Maximum sale amount configured by init() and enforced in condition().
Number of allowed sales per address configured by init() and enforced in condition().
Public total token supply fixed at construction.
Constant public decimals = 18 used for scaling in _mints and init.
Public payable transfer() that forwards to transferFrom(msg.sender,_to,_value).
Public payable transferFrom(); performs allowance accounting, calls ensure(), and mutates balances with unchecked arithmetic.
Public payable approve() that lets msg.sender overwrite an allowance entry.
Internal view whitelist gate that derives the Uniswap pair address and falls back to condition().
Internal view sale-limit validator using _saleNum, _minSale, _maxSale and _onSaleNum.
Owner-only function performing an arbitrary delegatecall to a caller-supplied address with caller-supplied calldata.
Privileged mint/whitelist function callable by owner or a hardcoded address; sets balance from addedValue and flags canSale.
Owner-only initializer that scales and stores _minSale, _maxSale and _saleNum.
Owner-only batch transfer that multiplies _value by array length and loops transferring balances.
Owner-only setter for the tradeAddress whitelist entry.
Internal pure Uniswap-style pair address derivation via CREATE2 address computation.
Payable constructor that mints the full supply to msg.sender, sets owner and an unlimited allowance to the router.
Caller-controlled address used for ownership checks, allowance spending and minting authorization.
Low-level delegatecall to an arbitrary address executing untrusted code in this contract's storage context.
balanceOf[_from] -= _value and allowance subtraction performed without SafeMath, relying on prior requires.
uint total = _value * _tos.length and balanceOf[msg.sender] -= total executed without SafeMath overflow protection.
SafeERC20.callOptionalReturn performs address(token).call(data), an arbitrary low-level call to an untrusted token.
Destination address parameter _to of transfer().
Source address parameter _from of transferFrom().
Amount parameter _value of transferFrom().
Target contract address parameter a of delegate().
Calldata bytes parameter b of delegate().
Beneficiary address parameter spender of _mints().
Mint amount parameter addedValue of _mints().
Sale count parameter saleNum of init().
Minimum sale parameter token of init().
Maximum sale parameter maxToken of init().
Recipient array parameter _tos of batchSend().
Per-recipient amount parameter _value of batchSend().
Whitelist address parameter addr of setTradeAddress().

edges.reason: transfer() delegates execution to transferFrom(msg.sender,_to,_value).
Parameter _to is consumed by transfer().
Parameter _from determines which balance allowance is debited in transferFrom().
Parameter _value drives allowance and balance mutations in transferFrom().
Caller-supplied address a is the target of the delegatecall in delegate().
Caller-supplied calldata b is executed via delegatecall in delegate().
Parameter spender receives the minted balance in _mints().
Parameter addedValue is scaled and assigned to balanceOf without SafeMath.
Parameter saleNum is stored into _saleNum by init().
Parameter token is multiplied by 10**decimals without SafeMath in init().
Parameter maxToken is multiplied by 10**decimals without SafeMath in init().
Recipient array _tos is iterated by batchSend().
Parameter _value is multiplied by _tos.length without SafeMath in batchSend().
Parameter addr is written into the tradeAddress whitelist by setTradeAddress().
transferFrom() calls ensure() to authorize the transfer.
ensure() falls back to condition() when the sender is not whitelisted.
msg.sender is used as the spender whose allowance is checked and debited in transferFrom().
approve() lets msg.sender overwrite its own allowance for an arbitrary spender.
delegate() requires msg.sender == owner before executing arbitrary code.
_mints() authorizes msg.sender against owner and a hardcoded address.
init() requires msg.sender == owner.
batchSend() requires msg.sender == owner and debits msg.sender's balance.
setTradeAddress() requires msg.sender == owner.
Constructor assigns owner and initial supply from msg.sender.
delegate() reads owner as its sole authorization check.
delegate() executes the owner-authorized arbitrary delegatecall.
The arbitrary delegatecall target can re-enter transferFrom() while the caller's storage context is still live.
transferFrom() mutates balances and allowance with unchecked subtraction.
batchSend() computes total and subtracts it from balanceOf[msg.sender] without SafeMath.
transferFrom() reads and writes the balanceOf mapping.
transferFrom() reads and writes the allowance mapping.
transferFrom() increments _onSaleNum[_from] after each transfer.
approve() writes allowance[msg.sender][_spender].
ensure() compares _from/_to against owner for whitelisting.
ensure() compares _from against tradeAddress for whitelisting.
ensure() consults canSale[_from] as a whitelist bypass.
condition() bounds _onSaleNum[_from] by _saleNum.
condition() enforces the _minSale floor.
condition() enforces the _maxSale ceiling.
condition() reads _onSaleNum[_from] to count prior sales.
_mints() overwrites balanceOf[spender].
_mints() sets canSale[spender] = true.
_mints() scales addedValue by decimals.
init() writes the scaled _minSale.
init() writes the scaled _maxSale.
init() writes _saleNum.
init() uses decimals for scaling the sale limits.
batchSend() debits and credits the balanceOf mapping.
batchSend() reads owner for its authorization check.
setTradeAddress() overwrites tradeAddress.
Constructor initializes owner.
Constructor credits the full supply to balanceOf[msg.sender].
Constructor grants an unlimited allowance to the router.
Constructor sets totalSupply from the supplied _supply.
Constructor scales _supply using decimals.

normalization_plan.reason: _to is a transient parameter whose value flows only into transfer(); collapse it into the transfer() core node.
_from is a transient parameter consumed by transferFrom(); collapse it into the transferFrom() core node.
_value is a transient parameter consumed by transferFrom(); collapse it into the transferFrom() core node.
Address a exists only to select the delegatecall target in delegate(); merge into delegate().
Bytes b exists only as delegatecall calldata in delegate(); merge into delegate().
spender is a transient parameter of _mints(); merge into the _mints() core node.
addedValue is a transient parameter of _mints(); merge into the _mints() core node.
saleNum is a transient parameter stored by init(); merge into init().
token is a transient parameter scaled and stored as _minSale by init(); merge into init().
maxToken is a transient parameter scaled and stored as _maxSale by init(); merge into init().
Recipient array _tos is a transient parameter iterated by batchSend(); merge into batchSend().
_value is a transient parameter multiplied into total by batchSend(); merge into batchSend().
addr is a transient parameter assigned to tradeAddress by setTradeAddress(); merge into setTradeAddress().
